item.name: Initiate an asynchronous copy of a model. Returns a token to check copy status.

request.name: Initiate an asynchronous copy of a model. Returns a token to check copy status.

description.content: Creates a full copy of the specified model. The copy is performed asynchronously in the background. Use the returned copy token to check the status of the copy operation. Note: Copy tokens are only valid for 24 hours after the copy is initiated. Library models cannot be copied in this version.

item.name: Check the status of an asynchronous model copy operation.

request.name: Check the status of an asynchronous model copy operation.

description.content: Returns the current status of a model copy operation initiated via the Copy endpoint. The status can be Running, Completed, or Failed. When completed, the response includes the ID of the newly created model. When failed, the response includes an error message. Note: Copy tokens are only valid for 24 hours.
